analyses.name: Dataset shift
analyses.question: What does the S2-fresh-384 add relative to S1-128?
methods: Compare S1-128 vs S2-fresh-384 distributions: game length, legal-action counts, chosen action types, policy entropy, visit entropy, value targets, duplicate observation/information-set rates.
Measure whether S2-fresh examples are near-duplicates of the S1/M22 self-play distribution or add new strategic contexts.
Compare S1 vs S2 first-128 nested overlap as a sanity check.

analyses.name: Shared-reference model behavior
analyses.question: On the same frozen S1 reference positions, how do S1 and S2 checkpoints differ in policy/value?
methods: Use the frozen S1 reference validation subset (game_index % 4 == 0, 1953 examples).
Compare S1/S2 policy entropy, top-1 agreement, policy CE vs targets, Value MSE/calibration, and phase/action-type sliced metrics.
Produce a shared-reference model behavior matrix.

analyses.name: M07 disagreement
analyses.question: Does S2 move closer to or farther from M07 on frozen stratified positions?
methods: Freeze a stratified position set from S1/S2 corpus balanced by phase, action type, and legal-action count.
Run M07 root analysis on those positions.
Measure S1/S2 policy vs M07 action choice/ranking agreement, rank correlation, top-1 agreement, and disagreement rates.
This is the key next-stage indicator.

analyses.name: Strength attribution
analyses.question: Which phase/action/confidence/value patterns explain the Arena anchor regression?
methods: Slice Arena results by opening/mid/endgame and action types where possible.
Correlate S2 vs S1 policy confidence and value error with M07 anchor delta.
Optionally run fixed-model search-budget sensitivity (sims 16/32/64) on a small frozen pair screen as a non-training attribution.
